rule: External workers own one complete result lane each. Tasks cannot finish at draft state when an approved executable action exists.

tasks.title: Promote 10 exact leads to verified contactable state
tasks.proof: company, source URL, exact contact route, fit reason, duplicate check, permission note
tasks.fallback: replace any unverifiable row with a smaller direct seller having public contact details

tasks.title: Prepare send-ready personalized messages and follow-up schedule
tasks.proof: approved row, approved message, channel, send state, follow-up dates
tasks.fallback: prepare drafts and sample assets while sending remains gated

tasks.title: Create payable path for every active offer
tasks.input: current offer files and company payment details
tasks.proof: quote template, invoice instructions, bank transfer path, payment state fields
tasks.fallback: manual written quote and bank transfer instructions before payment automation

tasks.title: Publish one working public sales demo
tasks.proof: public URL, smoke test, health state, rollback note
tasks.fallback: static public page or recorded product walkthrough with explicit NO_URL blocker

tasks.title: Create negotiation guardrails for first pilot
tasks.proof: scope, floor price, allowed concessions, objection replies, close conditions
tasks.fallback: fixed 199 EUR pilot with no custom expansion

tasks.title: Create complete first-pilot intake without repeated questions
tasks.proof: inputs, access, acceptance criteria, timeline, missing-data fallback

tasks.title: Create delivery-ready production queue for first paid pilot
tasks.proof: owner, tasks, output paths, QA, handoff, acceptance and feedback row
tasks.fallback: continue dry-run against a realistic sample brief

tasks.title: Create full external funnel event ledger
tasks.input: lead, send, reply, quote, payment and delivery states
tasks.proof: measurable transitions and drop-off reason for every active row

tasks.title: Create sender, claims and platform safety gate
tasks.input: outreach channels, public claims and data sources
tasks.proof: permission, source, claims evidence, bounce/spam limits and account-risk controls

tasks.title: Create retention and support handoff after delivery
tasks.proof: support SLA, renewal trigger, upsell route, churn reason

success_condition: At least one lead progresses through sent, reply, agreed scope, payable path, paid, delivered and accepted states with evidence.
failure_condition: The workforce creates more internal files but no external proof state moves. In that case EXT-COO must pause planning and route all capacity to the nearest blocked commercial transition.
